title: incident-bot: oncall runbook + SLO toolkit integration and telemetry enhancements
author: Diego Ramirez
release_notes: Enhances incident-bot with improved runbook linking, SLO-to-runbook heuristics, and additional telemetry to help on-call triage. Includes unit and e2e tests and console docs updates.
description:
Motivation: On recent incidents the on-call flow required better surface area for relevant runbooks and a clearer SLO->runbook mapping. This PR wires the incident-bot runbook scorer into the SLO toolkit, adds telemetry tags to on-call context messages, and exposes a small on-call helper for quick-runbook access in Slack. Changes include: - Runbook scorer: heuristics to score candidate runbooks by SLO tags, service ownership, and recent incident similarity. - SLO toolkit adapter: new lightweight adapter that returns top N runbooks for a given SLO context. - Telemetry: add runbook_id, score, and slo_id fields to incident-bot telemetry events to make triage flows searchable. - On-call helper: Slack button manifests and a new API endpoint for quick-runbook fetch. - Tests: unit tests for scorer heuristics and a new e2e that validates runbook links appear in on-call messages for a synthetic incident. - Docs: console docs + runbook linking guide. Checklist:
- [x] Runbook scorer implementation
- [x] SLO toolkit adapter + feature flag (incident.runbook_linking.enabled)
- [x] Telemetry events added and documented
- [x] Unit and e2e tests
- [x] Docs and changelog entry
Notes: The SLO adapter is behind a runtime feature flag and defaults to off. We fall back to the existing keyword-based runbook matcher when flagged off. This approach lets us enable for a subset of customers and measure value via the tracing hooks added in this PR. See ENG-8492 for rollout plan.
commits: feat(incident-bot): add runbook scorer and scoring tests
feat(telemetry): emit runbook_id, runbook_score, slo_id on incident events
test(e2e): add synthetic incident e2e for runbook linking
docs: runbook linking guide and console screenshots
fix(slack): ensure button payload uses v2 schema
review_comments: Aisha Khan: The scorer looks good overall — can we add a short timeout in the adapter when calling the runbook DB to avoid blocking?
Diego Ramirez: Added a 200ms timeout and a retry guard, noted in scorer.py (second commit)
Jonah Park: CI flaked on the e2e in the first run due to test ordering; please ensure test sandbox isolation
Diego Ramirez: Reordered the e2e and isolated the synthetic incident namespace, pushed fix
Lena Ortiz: Approve after CI passes and docs include a note about the feature flag for enterprise customers
notes: Initial CI had a flaky e2e failure caused by shared test namespace; fixed by namespacing synthetic incidents. Feature is behind a flag. Plan is to roll out to 5% of traffic for one week and evaluate runbook click-through and MTTR impact.
